item_name: Rothco Deluxe Korea Veteran Low Profile Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe Korea Veteran Low Profile Insignia Cap is a tribute to those who served in the Korean War. This baseball-styled cap features beautifully embroidered "Korea Veteran" lettering along with the iconic service ribbon on the front panel, showcasing a proud display of veteran status. The sandwich-style brim includes an additional “Korea Veteran” embroidered in bold yellow for an extra touch of distinction. Crafted from durable cotton twill, this veteran cap is designed for long-lasting wear.
